definitions.short: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
definitions.usage: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), × utterly.

Neh 10:29 combines a. & c. separate oneself הָאֱלֹהִים אֶלתּֿוֺרַת הָֽאֲרָצוֺת מֵעַמֵּי . 2 passive, be separated . a. be excluded from the people, followed by מִן Ezra 10:8 . b. be set apart , of Aaron, followed by לְהַקְדִּישׁוֺ 1Chr 23:13 . — On הבדיל , & distinction from הפריד see Dr JPhoenician xi. 219 .
